cases.title: API search endpoint handles parallel flower and vendor queries
cases.preconditions: API endpoint is live, products and vendors tables have matching data
cases.steps: 1. Call GET /api/search?q=bloom&scope=all 2. Inspect both flowers and vendors arrays 3. Verify response time
cases.expected: Status 200 is returned; both flowers and vendors arrays are populated; response time is under 500ms; no data duplication across arrays

cases.title: missing product_images relation falls back gracefully
cases.preconditions: Database schema has products but product_images relation is unavailable
cases.testData: Query that references product_images on missing relation
cases.steps: 1. Call API search with query that should trigger product_images select 2. Observe response and logs
cases.expected: API returns 200 or 207; flowers are returned without product_images; controlled error is logged; request does not fail entirely

cases.title: empty search query returns empty arrays
cases.preconditions: API endpoint is live, search route is accessible
cases.steps: 1. Call GET /api/search?q=&scope=all 2. Check response payload
cases.expected: Status 200 is returned; flowers array is empty []; vendors array is empty []; no error message; page remains usable

cases.title: invalid price parameter is ignored with fallback
cases.preconditions: API endpoint is live
cases.steps: 1. Call GET /api/search?q=rose&price=invalid_price 2. Inspect results
cases.expected: API ignores invalid price and returns all products; price filter defaults to 'Any'; results are not empty if matches exist

cases.title: database query fails and returns 207 status with errors array
cases.preconditions: One database query fails while another succeeds
cases.testData: Simulated database error on products query but vendors succeeds
cases.steps: 1. Call GET /api/search?q=test&scope=all with one query failing 2. Inspect status and errors array
cases.expected: Status 207 is returned (partial success); successful data (vendors) is preserved; errors array contains the failure message; client can gracefully handle mixed results

cases.title: unknown scope parameter defaults to 'all'
cases.preconditions: API endpoint is live
cases.steps: 1. Call GET /api/search?q=flower&scope=invalid_scope 2. Observe returned data
cases.expected: Scope defaults to 'all'; API returns both flowers and vendors; no error is thrown; results are consistent with 'all' scope

cases.title: price sorting is applied but does not affect vendor results
cases.preconditions: Database has vendors and products at different price points
cases.testData: query='shop', sort='Price: Low to High', scope='all'
cases.steps: 1. Call GET /api/search with mixed scope and price sort 2. Compare returned arrays
cases.expected: Flowers array is sorted by price; vendors array ignores price sort and returns with default ordering; both arrays remain separate and unmangled

cases.title: API search endpoint returns filtered flower results
cases.preconditions: API endpoint is live, products table has data with images
cases.steps: 1. Call GET /api/search?q=rose&scope=flowers&price=<1000 2. Parse response payload 3. Validate returned structure
cases.expected: Status 200 is returned; response includes flowers array with product_name, price, product_images; vendors array is empty; product_images contain image_url and display_order

cases.title: password validation prevents weak passwords
cases.preconditions: Signup form is visible and functional
cases.steps: 1. Navigate to /sign-up 2. Try to signup with weak password 3. Submit form
cases.expected: Form validation catches weak password; error message appears (e.g., 'Password must be at least 8 characters'); signup request is not sent; user can re-enter stronger password

cases.title: duplicate email is rejected during registration
cases.preconditions: User with email already exists in auth.users
cases.steps: 1. Navigate to /sign-up 2. Enter email of existing user 3. Submit form
cases.expected: Supabase returns 'User already registered' error; signup form displays error; user is guided to login instead; no duplicate records are created

cases.title: password mismatch is caught before submission
cases.preconditions: Signup form is open
cases.steps: 1. Fill signup form with mismatched passwords 2. Submit form
cases.expected: Client-side validation triggers error: 'Passwords do not match'; form submission is blocked; user can correct and retry

cases.title: email format validation prevents invalid emails
cases.preconditions: Signup form is accessible
cases.steps: 1. Navigate to /sign-up 2. Enter invalid email format 3. Try to submit form
cases.expected: Email validation fails; error message 'Please enter a valid email' appears; form submission is blocked; input field may show red border

cases.title: username field cannot be empty
cases.preconditions: Signup form is visible
cases.steps: 1. Navigate to /sign-up 2. Leave username field empty 3. Attempt to submit form
cases.expected: Form validation error shows 'Username is required'; form submission is blocked; user must enter username before proceeding

cases.title: signup fails when Supabase service is unavailable
cases.preconditions: Supabase auth service is down or unreachable
cases.steps: 1. Navigate to /sign-up with service down 2. Fill valid form data 3. Submit form 4. Observe error handling
cases.expected: Signup request fails gracefully; error message displays 'Service unavailable, please try again later'; form remains populated; user can retry when service returns

cases.title: long username or email is truncated or rejected appropriately
cases.preconditions: Very long email or username provided
cases.steps: 1. Fill signup form with oversized inputs 2. Submit form
cases.expected: Form validation catches length limits; error appears: 'Email/username too long'; request is not sent; user sees length requirements

cases.title: confirmation email is sent with valid callback link
cases.preconditions: Signup completed, email service configured
cases.testData: Email service: SendGrid or Supabase email
cases.steps: 1. Complete signup form 2. Check inbox for confirmation email 3. Click email link 4. Verify redirect to confirmation page
cases.expected: Confirmation email arrives within 2 minutes; email contains valid link to /auth/callback; clicking link confirms email; user is redirected to login or dashboard

cases.title: welcome email contains user information and next steps
cases.preconditions: Signup completed and email template configured
cases.testData: Email template with variables for username and action links
cases.steps: 1. Complete signup 2. Check welcome email 3. Verify content includes username, next steps, and support info
cases.expected: Email contains: user's username, clear next steps (confirm email, login), support contact info, company branding; email is readable on mobile and desktop

cases.title: missing email provider blocks notification sending
cases.preconditions: Email service is not configured or credentials are invalid
cases.testData: EMAIL_PROVIDER not set or invalid credentials
cases.steps: 1. Complete signup form 2. Observe backend logs 3. Check if email was sent
cases.expected: Signup succeeds but email is not sent; error is logged; user is notified: 'Confirmation email could not be sent'; user can request email resend

cases.title: email delivery fails and retry mechanism handles it
cases.preconditions: Email service returns temporary failure
cases.testData: Email service timeout or rate limit hit
cases.steps: 1. Complete signup with email service in failure state 2. Wait for retry logic 3. Check if email eventually arrives or user is notified
cases.expected: Initial send fails; backend retries 2-3 times; if all retries fail, user sees error: 'Unable to send email'; resend button is offered

cases.title: confirmation link expires after time window
cases.preconditions: Confirmation link generated but time limit exceeded before click
cases.steps: 1. Signup and receive confirmation email 2. Wait 24+ hours (or simulate expiration) 3. Click link 4. Observe error
cases.expected: Link is invalid; user sees: 'Confirmation link expired'; user is offered option to resend email; no user is auto-confirmed with expired link

cases.title: confirmation email fails for invalid email format in database
cases.preconditions: Email address stored incorrectly or is malformed
cases.steps: 1. Signup attempt with edge-case email format 2. Check if email notification queues 3. Observe error handling
cases.expected: Signup validation rejects malformed email before it reaches email service; error message: 'Invalid email format'; notification is never attempted

cases.title: double confirmation attempts do not send duplicate emails
cases.preconditions: User clicked confirm button twice or submitted multiple confirmation requests
cases.steps: 1. Signup and receive confirmation email 2. Click confirmation button twice rapidly 3. Check email inbox and system state
cases.expected: Idempotent confirmation: first click succeeds; second click shows: 'Already confirmed' or redirects to login; only one confirmation email is counted; user is not confused

cases.title: email did not send
cases.preconditions: User signed up and was notified that a confirmation email has been sent
cases.steps: 1. Signup and receive confirmation email 2. Check email / inbox
cases.expected: Email confirmation should be sent to the email
